request.system:
You draft one IQ/OQ Test Step for one URS requirement of pharmaceutical equipment. You get the requirement with its verified value and Coverage class, the vendor Evidence linked to it with why it does not prove the requirement, and the pages of the source documents.
description: what the step verifies, one sentence.
method: how to perform it, executable at the site; test the upper and lower limits or the worst case where the requirement has them.
instrument: the measuring instrument to use; null when the step measures nothing.
acceptance: the Acceptance Criterion, only when a source page prints it. kind: range (min and/or max), number, one_of (accepted texts in allowed, exactly as printed), text, present (a feature that must exist), or none. Numbers are plain JSON numbers (Indonesian documents write 1.000 for one thousand and 0,5 for one half); unit: a short English unit symbol such as mm, kN, rpm or °C.
acceptance_source: where the AC is printed: doc and rev of one of the given sources, the page number and a verbatim quote, at most 200 characters, that states the AC with its numbers as printed. Copy characters exactly.
Never invent, round or tighten a limit. If no source prints an AC for this requirement, answer kind none and acceptance_source null: a human sets it.

response.text: {"description":"Verifies that every part of TP-201 that contacts the product is made of SS 316L, by checking the MTC against the installed parts and confirming the grade of each product-contact part by positive material identification.","method":"Using the MTC-TP201-01 heat list, identify every part that contacts the product (hopper, feeder paddles, take-off scraper, tablet discharge chute, and any other product-contact part on the machine). Confirm on the installed machine that each part is marked or matches its heat number. Perform handheld XRF positive material identification on each product-contact part, testing the hopper and feeder paddles, which are the most frequent contact points, plus any part whose grade is unclear. Resolve the conflict: the MTC lists the feed frame housing as SS 304 under the product-contact header, so QA must confirm whether it contacts product. If it does, the requirement is not met and the MTC must be corrected or the part replaced. Record the results on the test sheet.","instrument":"Handheld XRF positive material identification analyzer","acceptance":{"kind":"one_of","min":null,"max":null,"number":null,"unit":null,"allowed":["SS 316L"],"text":null},"acceptance_source":{"doc":"URS-TP201","rev":1,"page":1,"quote":"Semua bagian yang kontak dengan produk terbuat dari SS 316L."}}
